policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="currentMovieId" value="@((Guid)context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["id"])" />
        

        

        @{
            var body = context.Request.Body.As();

            var movie = new
            {
                PartitionKey = "movies",
                RowKey = (Guid)body["id"],
                Title = (string)body["title"],
                Description = (string)body["description"],
                Year = (int)body["year"]
            };

            return JsonConvert.SerializeObject(movie);
        }
